items.title: Build Your Own LEGO Escape Room
items.description: Plan and build thrilling LEGO® escape rooms! Follow one of three themed escape rooms: Egyptian Quest, Space Mission, and Safari Adventure. Or pick and choose from more than 30 LEGO puzzles to create your own escape rooms from scratch. Build tips Step-by-step guides to running the rooms Theme inspiration Puzzle ideas And much more! ©2022 The LEGO Group.
